    Split basic algebras from primitive idempotents #

    Over an algebraically closed field, a finite-dimensional algebra with a complete set of pairwise non-isomorphic primitive orthogonal idempotents is split basic (SplitBasicData): each corner g A g is local with residue field k, and the off-diagonal corners lie in the radical.

    source
    def LargeIndecomposable.IsoData {A : Type u} [Ring A] (a b : A) :
    Prop

    aA ≅ bA, by elements x ∈ aAb, y ∈ bAa with xy = a, yx = b. (Adapted from BasicCorner.lean of multiplicative-bases-deformations.)
